item.title: Configure Emacs for Python development
item.description: I like to have the same development environment on the local machine and remote servers. In this case it’s possible to write and debug programs not only with your laptop, but also using lightweight tablet or netbook and at the same time have all stuff you have used to like fast CPU, enough memory and all the features of IDE like code navigation or autocompletion. I prefer using Emacs on the Ubuntu machine to achieve this goal.
